title: UP BOARD CLASS 1 — Environmental Studies | Economic Activities
description: Subject-wise test on Economic Activities (Environmental Studies) for UP BOARD CLASS 1. 40Q.
subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Who teaches you in the school?
questions.explanation: A teacher's job is to teach children in school and help them learn new things.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Who helps us when we are sick?
questions.explanation: A doctor examines us, tells us what is wrong, and gives medicine to help us get better when we are sick.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Which person brings letters and parcels to our home?
questions.explanation: A postman's job is to collect and deliver letters and parcels to different houses and offices.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Who makes delicious bread and cakes?
questions.explanation: A baker is a person who bakes bread, cakes, pastries, and other yummy items, usually in a bakery.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: What tool does a doctor use to listen to your heartbeat?
questions.explanation: A stethoscope is a special instrument used by doctors to listen to the sounds inside a patient's body, like the heartbeat and breathing.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Where does a farmer usually work to grow food for us?
questions.explanation: Farmers work hard in fields (also called farms) to plant seeds, grow crops, and produce food like grains, fruits, and vegetables.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: If your shoes are torn or need fixing, whom would you go to for repair?
questions.explanation: A cobbler is a skilled person who repairs shoes, sandals, and other footwear, making them look new again.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Which of these people helps build new houses and buildings?
questions.explanation: A mason is a worker who builds structures like walls and houses using bricks, stones, and cement.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Why do people do different kinds of jobs?

options.text: To earn money and help others

questions.explanation: People work in different jobs to earn money to buy things they need (like food and clothes) and to provide useful services or goods that help the community.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: If you see a big fire in your neighbourhood, whom should you call for help immediately?
questions.explanation: Firefighters are brave people trained to put out fires, rescue people from dangerous situations, and help in emergencies involving fire.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Who helps us when we are sick or unwell?
questions.explanation: A doctor is a person who treats sick people and helps them get better.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: What does a tailor use to sew clothes?
questions.explanation: A tailor's main tools for sewing clothes are a needle and thread.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Who grows food grains and vegetables for us in the fields?
questions.explanation: A farmer is a person who works in the fields to grow crops, grains, and vegetables that we eat.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Which of these people helps to build houses?
questions.explanation: A mason or builder is a skilled worker who constructs houses and other buildings.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Why do people do different jobs like a teacher, doctor, or farmer?

options.text: To earn money and provide useful services

questions.explanation: People work to earn money to buy things they need and also to provide valuable services that help others in the community.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: If you want to buy some fresh bread and cakes, where would you go?
questions.explanation: A bakery is a place where a baker bakes and sells fresh bread, cakes, and other baked goods.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: What is the main role of a police officer in our community?

options.text: To keep people safe and maintain order

questions.explanation: A police officer's job is to protect people, ensure their safety, and maintain law and order in the community.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Which of these items do we usually buy from a shopkeeper?
questions.explanation: A shopkeeper sells various goods like biscuits, soap, groceries, and other daily necessities that we buy.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question:
Read the two sentences:
Statement 1: A carpenter makes chairs and tables from wood.
Statement 2: People need chairs and tables for their homes and schools.
Which of the following is true about these statements?

options.text: Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 are true, and Statement 2 explains why a carpenter's job is important.
Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 are false.

questions.explanation: Statement 1 correctly describes the work of a carpenter. Statement 2 explains the demand and necessity for these items, highlighting the importance of the carpenter's economic activity.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Little Riya's favorite toy car is broken and needs to be fixed. Who should her parents take the toy car to for repair?
questions.explanation: A mechanic is a person whose job involves repairing machines and mechanical devices, which would include a toy car.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Who helps us when we are sick or not feeling well?
questions.explanation: A doctor is a professional who treats sick people and helps them get better.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Which person teaches children in school?
questions.explanation: A teacher's job is to educate and guide children in their learning at school.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Who works in the fields to grow grains and vegetables for us to eat?
questions.explanation: A farmer cultivates crops and vegetables, which are essential for our food supply.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: If your house needs a new wall or repairs, who would you call to build or fix it?
questions.explanation: A mason is skilled in working with bricks and cement to build and repair structures like walls and houses.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Your shoe sole is coming off. Who can fix your broken shoe?
questions.explanation: A cobbler is a person whose job is to repair shoes and other leather goods.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: What is the main job of a shopkeeper?

options.text: To drive a bus for passengers
To sew new clothes for people
To sell various goods to people
To catch thieves and keep us safe

questions.explanation: A shopkeeper manages a shop and sells different items to customers who come to buy them.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Which special tool does a doctor often use to listen to our heartbeat and breathing?
questions.explanation: A stethoscope is a medical instrument used by doctors to listen to internal sounds of the body, such as the heart and lungs.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: What is the primary role of a police officer in our community?

options.text: Keeping us safe and maintaining law and order
Fixing leaky water pipes in houses

questions.explanation: Police officers are responsible for protecting people, preventing crime, and ensuring that rules and laws are followed to maintain peace and safety.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Rohan wants a new shirt for his birthday. Who will help him by cutting and stitching the cloth to make it?
questions.explanation: A tailor is a person who designs, measures, cuts, and sews fabric to make clothes for people.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Imagine a world where there are no farmers. What major problem would everyone face?

options.text: Our houses would not be built.
We would not have electricity in our homes.
We would not have food to eat.
No one would teach us in school.

questions.explanation: Farmers are crucial because they grow all the food (grains, fruits, vegetables) that we need to survive. Without them, there would be no food.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Who grows fruits and vegetables for us to eat?
questions.explanation: A farmer is the person who works in the field to grow crops, fruits, and vegetables for us.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: If you want to learn new things and read books, who helps you in school?
questions.explanation: A teacher is the person who teaches students in school and helps them learn new things.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: What does a doctor do?
questions.explanation: A doctor's job is to examine and treat people who are ill or injured.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Which of these people helps to keep our neighbourhood safe?
questions.explanation: A policeman's main duty is to maintain law and order and ensure the safety of people and their property.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Your mother wants a new dress. Who will stitch it for her?
questions.explanation: A tailor is a person whose job is to make, mend, or alter clothes.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Which of these jobs involves working with wood to make furniture like chairs and tables?
questions.explanation: A carpenter is a person who builds or repairs wooden objects and structures, such as furniture.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: People do different types of jobs mainly to:

options.text: Earn money to buy things they need

questions.explanation: People do jobs (economic activities) primarily to earn money, which helps them meet their basic needs like food, clothing, and shelter.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Match the person with their workplace: Person: Teacher, Doctor Workplace: Hospital, School Which pair is correct?
questions.explanation: A teacher works in a school, and a doctor works in a hospital. Therefore, Teacher - School is the correct match.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Rahul's family needs fresh bread every morning. They go to a shop where a person bakes delicious bread and cakes. What is the job of the person who bakes bread and cakes?
questions.explanation: A baker is a person whose profession is to prepare and bake bread, cakes, and other pastries.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs

questions.question: Why is it good that different people do different kinds of jobs in our society?

options.text: So that everyone can do the same job.
So that all our needs like food, clothes, and houses can be fulfilled by different people.
So that no one has to work.
So that only one person does all the work.

questions.explanation: Different people doing different jobs (division of labor) ensures that all the varied needs of a society (like food grown by farmers, clothes stitched by tailors, houses built by masons) are met.
questions.subject: upbo1-evs
